extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, regulated parties, agency staff, and legal practitioners seeking or navigating Title 7 (Agriculture) of the Code of Federal Regulations
extracted.subtask_description: Reference/index page for Title 7 of the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR), including navigation guidance, legal-status notes, and a table of contents listing subtitles, parts, and chapters for USDA-related regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal status of the eCFR
rubrics_metrics.description: The Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR) is a continuously updated online version of the CFR. It is not an official legal edition of the CFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should be aware the eCFR is an editorially maintained, updated online resource; see 'Learn more' about its status and editorial process for details on reliability and use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Published (official) CFR on govinfo
rubrics_metrics.description: The published edition of the CFR (viewable on govinfo.gov) is the most recent official printed publication of the CFR, which is updated annually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The official published edition may not include the most recent changes applied to the CFR; use govinfo.gov for the official annual publication but consult the eCFR for the continuously updated text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced content purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhanced content is provided to the user to provide additional context (for example, FR references, timeline, historical versions, and developer resources).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhanced content items (FR Reference, Timeline, Historical Versions, Developer Tools, etc.) are supplementary materials intended to give context to the regulatory text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigation and search guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can navigate by entering citations or phrases (e.g., '1 CFR 1.1' or '49 CFR 172.101'); choosing an item from citations and headings brings you directly to content; choosing a full-text search result brings you to those results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page gives examples and points to a 'Search & Navigation' guide; pressing Enter in the search box triggers search. Use citations/headings or full-text search to locate specific regulatory provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title 7 organization and table of contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Title 7 (Agriculture) is organized into subtitles, parts, and chapters corresponding to agencies and subject areas (e.g., Subtitle A: Office of the Secretary of Agriculture; Chapters for USDA agencies with part number ranges).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists parts and chapters with their numeric ranges and indicates reserved parts; links and features (view historical versions, view changes, drafting site) are provided to access specific parts, recent changes, and drafting tools.
